placement.claim: Proposal meaning is approved for a distinct agent-instruction structure and placement reviewer whose primary consumer is implementation review of actual normative agent-facing text and whose proposal-review use is conditional on present instruction contracts. The probable repository-local skill placement remains subject to the proposal's named dogfood and reopening conditions.

reopening_conditions: Dogfood cannot produce materially distinct findings from existing architecture, doctrine-authority, or seam review.
The two-question diagnostic systematically demotes exact routes that are causally required for safety, authority, validity, or observability.
A fresh reviewer cannot judge instruction placement without loading so much neighboring context that a distinct specialist loses its bounded-context value.
Proposal and implementation subjects require incompatible reviewer contracts or evidence lifecycles.
Observed consumers require a different skill, profile, review-artifact, or coordination owner than the probable placement.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner

relationships.rationale: Adaptive coordination may select this specialist when materially normative agent text is present, but the reviewer can operate without the coordinator and retains ownership of its scoped findings.
A mature workflow may publish findings through the shared review-artifact profile, but initial dogfood can use exact Git-bound review records without accepting that proposal's placement.

Instruction findings may advise proposal revision when a proposal contains actual normative agent text; ordinary proposals that merely anticipate future instruction implementation do not select this reviewer.
